inputs: EPA default fleet and national activity normalization; county default meteorology/fuels; not observed 2025 local inputs

table_filters.fuelsupply: NY County fuelRegionID=1170011000, fuelYearID=2025, fuelTypeID IN (1,2,3,9)
table_filters.fuelformulation: Formulations referenced by selected fuel supply
table_filters.avft: Official alternate AVFT derivation; sourceTypeID IN (52,53,61,62)

note: Population and VMT default totals normalize per-distance rates; they are not estimates of NYC population/VMT. No MTA short-/long-haul weighting.
fuel_configuration: County mode simulates all permitted fuels; export selects diesel fuelTypeID=2 after fuel-separated output.
dependencies: CO2 requires total energy consumption 91; PM2.5 requires component pollutants 112,115,118,119. Only 90,3,110 are exported.
avft_derivation: SUM(stmyFraction) by sourceTypeModelYearID,fuelTypeID,engTechID from movesdb20241112.samplevehiclepopulation, as in EPA FuelImporter alternate AVFT export.
input_table_note: Preparation filters describe copied inputs. MOVES additionally creates zero-population rows for unselected source types; archived tables reflect the validated engine-ready input database.
